summary_cs: Listicle: 4 free open-source náhrady placených Mac appek – macshot (CleanShot X), PureMac (CleanMyMac), FreeFlow (Wispr Flow, potřebuje free Groq klíč) a OpenScreen (Screen Studio, ještě early). Vše ověřeno v README; linky: github.com/sw33tLie/macshot, github.com/momenbasel/puremac, github.com/zachlatta/freeflow, github.com/getopenscreen/openscreen.
